scope: Independent source-grounding/design audit of the physical experimental family, not an implementation, experimental validation or scientific simulation
decision: Source-bounded family design is supportable with the listed explicit gates and provenance boundaries. This is not turnkey replication approval.

source_identity.license: CC BY 4.0 subject to source third-party credit exceptions

review_basis.preflight: Full main and SI text plus all 18 rendered pages were inspected in recorded source preflight; this audit relies on that full visual coverage and independently re-reads relevant text.

snapshot_note: Parallel authorship continued during audit. Snapshot hashes identify reviewed design files and are not a claim that all later files were independently re-audited.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p7, Resin and matrix preparation
findings.finding: Acetone is used to predissolve initiator, but amount and subsequent fate are unreported.
findings.design_implication: Do not silently evaporate, retain, or ignore solvent. Resolve quantity, basis and handling or use a qualified preformulated input.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p7, Resin and matrix preparation
findings.finding: The CQ/EDAB percentage does not explicitly disambiguate each component versus their combined amount.
findings.design_implication: Resolve interpretation and any ratio before dispensing Mat1.

findings.source_locator: SI p4, Fig2 legends; MAIN p5, rheological characterization
findings.finding: The four R805 legend labels are 12%, 4%, 8%, 2%; the main text identifies the comparison as Mat2.
findings.design_implication: Record the set 2,4,8,12 percent as visually verified. The legend itself does not state denominator; full per-condition recipe and allocation remain qualified inputs.

findings.source_locator: SI p5, Fig4a
findings.finding: Straight-channel diameters are 2.00,1.50,1.00,0.50,0.30 mm; channel length is 4.00 mm.
findings.design_implication: These source geometry facts can replace a wholly unknown diameter set, but do not supply the full cylinder CAD or feature coordinates.

findings.source_locator: SI pp5-6, Figs4 and6; MAIN pp4-6, resolution discussion
findings.finding: Pure-VAM negative-feature and positive-feature resolution controls do not explicitly name their resin formulation in these captions or discussion.
findings.design_implication: A MAT2 choice for either control is an authored task realization requiring declared work-order qualification; do not label it a verified source material mapping.

findings.source_locator: SI p5, Fig4
findings.finding: The pure-VAM negative-feature figure contains model and printed-sample imagery. A dedicated CT acquisition is not stated for this control.
findings.design_implication: Any added CT examination is an authored characterization extension. Keep source-observed imagery and new measurements distinct.

findings.source_locator: MAIN pp5-6, Fig4a-b; MAIN p8, photorheology
findings.finding: Reported gelation times 59.8 s (Mat1) and 64.7 s (Mat2) use measurement start; LED turns on at 30 s.
findings.design_implication: Maintain measurement and exposure clocks. Subtractions 29.8 s and 34.7 s are derived exposure-relative intervals, not separately reported source values. Never set printing exposure from these rheometer times.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p5 text and p6 Fig4d-e caption/panels
findings.finding: Mat1 recovery is 4.7 s and Mat2 recovery is 1.7 s. A prose cross-reference places Mat1 at Fig4e, conflicting with the panel/caption mapping d=Mat1,e=Mat2.
findings.design_implication: Preserve material-value pairing, report the source reference conflict, and use panel/caption identifiers explicitly.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p8, rheology; Fig4d-e
findings.finding: Recovery Methods describe 30% amplitude for 60 s then 0.01% for 60 s, repeated to a stated total of 240 s. Figure shows one high-low cycle.
findings.design_implication: Use two high-low pairs for 240 s, not an invented six-interval 360 s sequence. Recovery delay starts at amplitude reduction.

findings.source_locator: SI p1, Table1; MAIN p5, Fig3
findings.finding: Table1 names Cylindrical chip (3c), 12/121/133 s, and Flat chip (3g), 8/148/156 s; main Fig3c is flat Y and Fig3g is cylindrical.
findings.design_implication: Do not silently resolve whether names or panel references identify timing rows. Preserve both rows and leave row-to-chip mapping unresolved.

findings.source_locator: SI p1, Table1; MAIN p7, print Methods
findings.finding: Table1 totals sum EMB3D and TVAM times. The less-than-six-minute statement excludes extraction, washing, channel flushing, postcuring and characterization.
findings.design_implication: Never claim complete physical end-to-end work under six minutes. Timings are historical context, not stop criteria.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p7, print Methods
findings.finding: The source states a cylindrical 5 mL vial, not an exact 5 mL fill. The extrusion holder accepts 2 mL syringes, without reporting a 2 mL load.
findings.design_implication: Separate capacity from actual allocated volume.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p7, print Methods; SI p5, Fig5
findings.finding: Routine needle internal diameter is 0.4 mm. The fine-channel demonstration specifies a 150 micrometre needle.
findings.design_implication: Fine-channel setup is an explicit exception; do not carry the routine line settings into it as established source facts.

findings.source_locator: SI p5, Fig5
findings.finding: Fine-channel modeled diameters are 120 micrometres helical and 300 micrometres straight; measured examples are 119 and 335 micrometres. Source attributes the larger straight channel to crossing the same location twice.
findings.design_implication: Keep CAD dimensions, needle diameter, observed section diameters and path-crossing counts distinct.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p7, print Methods
findings.finding: Part recovery is followed by glycerol washing and five-minute postcure; for negative EmVP, isopropanol/compressed-air channel flushing occurs before postcure.
findings.design_implication: Channel-clearing cannot be moved after postcure. Pressure, amount, connection and clearance criteria are not supplied by the paper.

findings.source_locator: MAIN pp3-4, accuracy discussion; MAIN p8, distance Methods; SI p7, Fig8
findings.finding: The source calls its comparison Hausdorff while describing mean distance and CloudCompare Cloud-to-Mesh analysis; it reports 0.23 +/- 0.28 mm.
findings.design_implication: Name the actual implemented statistic. Do not identify the reported mean as the mathematical maximum Hausdorff distance or treat it as a universal acceptance limit.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p8, Shore D hardness Methods
findings.finding: Printed samples are probed at four sites, 15 s per reading. Sample replicate count, coupon dimensions and exact printing method are not supplied.
findings.design_implication: Four sites are not four independent specimens. A VAM-produced coupon is an authored realization, not historical evidence of the fabrication method.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p8, tensile Methods; SI p8, Fig10
findings.finding: Tensile specimens are cast, with a scaled-down ISO 527-1 reference. Estimated moduli are 122 MPa for Mat1 and 1.28 MPa for Mat2.
findings.design_implication: Do not label these tensile results as measured on printed EmVP parts. Source omits scaled dimensions, casting/cure program, test rate, strain measurement and fit details.

findings.source_locator: SI p6, Fig6
findings.finding: Pure-VAM cages have outer diameters 10,5,2.5 mm and illustrated beam diameters approximately 2,0.7,0.3 mm; the smallest cage is not evenly resolved.
findings.design_implication: Do not convert the 0.3 mm observation into an unconditional successful printer resolution specification. Preserve uneven/partial failure.

findings.source_locator: SI p6, Fig7
findings.finding: Embedded Mat1-in-Mat2 cage shows travel bridges/oozing. An individual filament view has height 250 micrometres and cross-section diameter about 175 micrometres.
findings.design_implication: Do not conflate height, cross-section diameter, tool diameter and commanded line size. Microscopy recovery/fixation/cure sequence is incomplete and must be supplied.

findings.source_locator: MAIN pp2-4, positive EmVP; SI p3, Fig1
findings.finding: Combined-material printing selectively cures within deposited Mat1; residual uncured Mat1 remains. SI also shows Mat1-only and Mat2-only cage controls.
findings.design_implication: Do not require all deposited Mat1 to become the final part. Do not omit Mat1-only control solely because the Fig4 caption discusses its higher absorption.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p7, setup/projection Methods; SI pp7-9, Figs9,11,12
findings.finding: A configured custom Cartesian extrusion printer, LCD VAM setup and a projection-generation method are described, but full hardware build, production CAD, job assets and operating calibration are not furnished by this packet.
findings.design_implication: Require installed qualified instruments plus versioned geometry/G-code/projection inputs; source cites construction/code assets that were not inspected. No third-party scientific code was executed.

findings.source_locator: SI p7, Fig9; MAIN p7, vial transfer
findings.finding: Model, projection, extrusion and VAM reference frames use XY center and model-bottom Z origins. Vial orientation is maintained during transfer.
findings.design_implication: This does not establish fixture dimensions, tolerance, angular zero or a universally self-aligning transfer. Keep an explicit transform and verification gate.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p7, print completion; SI p9, Fig11
findings.finding: Completion uses a 620 nm orthogonal shadowgram compared with intended shape.
findings.design_implication: No quantitative image-match threshold, maximum safe duration or automated observer is supplied. These are external qualification inputs.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p8, microCT and UV Vis Methods
findings.finding: MicroCT specifies 20 micrometre spot, 0.62 s exposure, 10 W and 15 micrometre voxel size; UV Vis specifies 400-550 nm and 1 cm PMMA cuvette.
findings.design_implication: These are incomplete instrument programs. Do not infer projection count, total scan time, voltage/current, segmentation, blank or acquisition interval.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p4, Fig2c/j/l; MAIN p5, Fig3
findings.finding: Source demonstrations include a 3 g stirring bar on the cage, negative-pressure bellow bending, Y-junction colored-water co-flow and separate cylindrical channels.
findings.design_implication: Pressure/flow programs, quantitative endpoints and connector details are missing. Cylindrical separated channels do not imply a Y co-flow junction.

findings.source_locator: SI p9, Fig12; SI p2, Table2
findings.finding: Fig12 is simulated light-intensity context, with 2,6,8 mm Mat1 inclusions; Table2 compares methods.
findings.design_implication: Retain as conceptual/computational context, not additional physical experiment branches or evidence of a locally executed simulation.

findings.source_locator: MAIN p8, Data availability; primary packet scope
findings.finding: Source Data, supplementary movies/code and the referenced hardware article were not inspected in this audit.
findings.design_implication: Do not claim raw data replication, validated code behavior, video-derived actions or full device reconstruction. Source results are contextual observations, never manufactured task outcomes.

release_conditions: Keep both pure-VAM control material assignments explicitly authored/unverified as historical source facts.
Retain Table1 chip-identity conflict and recovery-panel cross-reference conflict.
Use the resolved figure-only lists without claiming a complete CAD or recipe.
Maintain the source-image-based pure-VAM negative control; any future added CT must remain an explicitly authored extension.
Keep all unresolved recipe, calibration, geometry, acquisition, endpoint and replication parameters blocking only their dependent work.
Do not claim source agreement, scientific reproducibility, robot execution or simulation from this source audit.
audit_limitations: No raw source-data spreadsheet, supplementary movies, supplementary code, referenced hardware article, CAD or printer assets were examined.
Independent implementation/static test results belong to their separate reports.
This audit does not validate current instruments, chemical handling, numerical algorithms, statistical power or observed scientific outcomes.
final_source_defect_status: No remaining substantive source-grounding defect identified in the final targeted review. Recipe, asset, geometry and acquisition gaps remain explicit and prevent turnkey execution.
final_targeted_recheck: R805 levels and denominator gate verified
single-material cage separate condition routes verified
